question: For each subnet name and its gateway IP, show the maximum IP version among subnets whose network has a RBAC action of 'access_as_shared' and whose RBAC target tenant is public (`'*'`), keeping only groups where that maximum IP version is greater than 3; also include, for each result row, the overall average of these per-(subnet name, gateway IP) maximum IP versions across all such groups. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH per_group AS (
  SELECT 
    s.name AS subnet_name,
    s.gateway_ip,
    MAX(s.ip_version) AS max_ip_version
  FROM subnets s
  JOIN networkrbacs r ON s.network_id = r.object_id
  WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared'
    AND r.target_tenant = '*'
  GROUP BY s.name, s.gateway_ip
  HAVING MAX(s.ip_version) > 3
)
SELECT 
  pg.subnet_name,
  pg.gateway_ip,
  pg.max_ip_version,
  oa.overall_avg
FROM per_group pg
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT AVG(max_ip_version) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_group
) oa
